ORDER TO SHOW CAUSE FOR CHANGE OF NAME
Off Calendar Feb-11-2003 Granted Per Written Order
MINI MINUTES: This cause came on regularly as scheduled for hearing this day. Commissioner: Loretta M. Norris; Clerk: P. Dias; Reporter: Patricia M. Evezich. Petitioner Rebecca Jane Ulrey was sworn and examined. The Court grants decree changing name to Russell James Ulrey. Decree signed in open court.
